newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan court rejects Bhutto plea against ouster.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan court rejects Bhutto plea against ouster.

text.p: Pakistan's Supreme Court refused for a second time on Saturday to accept a petition by ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto against her dismissal.
State-run television said the court registrar had told Bhutto's lawyer Aitzaz Ahsan he could appeal against the decision if he was unhappy with the refusal.
Ahsan filed an amended petition in the Supreme Court on Thursday, deleting portions of the original which the registrar had criticised as "frivolous and scandalous".
Ahsan said at the time he had refiled the petition to save time, but did not accept that the one submitted earlier had contained anything inappropriate.
He said he had written a letter to the registrar along with the amended petition to place on record Bhutto's disagreement with the court's rejection of the original.

The first petition's 42 pages contained blistering criticism of President Farooq Leghari for dismissing the National Assembly and ousting Bhutto. Leghari installed a caretaker government to hold fresh elections on February 3.
